accent.description: The accent colour of documents and emails; absent for the design's default. The app keeps its own colours.

accent_options.description: The accent colours to choose from: each reads against white at 4.5:1 or more.

dark.description: The logo for dark backgrounds; until one is added, dark screens show the light one on a white tile.

icon.description: The square icon, for the browser tab and the app icon.

version.description: The version in force; 0 until the first is saved. For If-Match.
